resources.string: Selfband needs microphone permission to record.
No tracks yet. The first track sets the start of the project.
Audio glitches during this take: alignment may be off.
Recording stopped because the audio device changed. The take was saved up to that point.
Audio glitches happened during the take. Alignment may be off.
Manual offset added on top of the automatic alignment. Positive = the track plays later.
The click plays only in your headphones. It is never recorded or exported. The count-in plays even with the metronome off.
This route is not calibrated yet.
Bluetooth adds a lot of latency (150–300 ms). Calibrate this route before recording.
Not calibrated: alignment uses stream timestamps only.
This input returns what the phone plays (%1$s dB). Old tracks will leak into new recordings.
Leak test: no playback returned on the input.
Not available on the loudspeaker (feedback risk). Use headphones.
Hear the input in the headphones (about %1$s ms late). Off if your interface monitors directly.
The output plays short sounds and the microphone picks them up. For the built-in mic: use the loudspeaker, or hold an earbud next to the mic.
Connect the interface output to its input with a cable. The most precise method for interfaces.
Play or tap along with the clicks. Works with any equipment, but is less precise.
Checks whether the interface sends what the phone plays back into its input. Keep your instrument silent.
Measures the latency of the current output and input, and saves it in this route\'s profile. Every new take on this route is aligned with it.
Playing test sounds… Keep quiet; the microphone must hear the sounds.
Playing test sounds through the cable…
Listen to 4 clicks, then play or tap along with the next 16, as tight as you can.
Playing test sounds… Keep your instrument silent and don\'t touch the cables.
Residual over timestamps: %1$s ms · spread %2$s ms · %3$d of %4$d measurements accepted
The spread is above 1 ms. Try again in a quieter place or with the loopback cable.
Save it to use it on every take recorded on this route.

Leak detected: the input returns the playback at %1$s dB, %2$s ms late. Old tracks will be heard inside new recordings. If the interface has a loopback or \"phone mix\" switch, turn it off. This was saved to the profile.
No leak: the input does not return what the phone plays. This was saved to the profile.
The test sounds were not detected. Check the volume, the cable or the microphone position, and try again.
The measurements did not agree with each other. Try again in a quieter place.
The measurement was interrupted (the audio device changed or the engine stopped).
